        companyName,
        phone,
        jobTitle,
        message,
        leadSource,
        interestArea,
        status,
        assignedTo,
        privacyConsentAccepted

        )

            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Lead Capture with this email already exists.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        INSERT INTO dbo.leadCaptures (
            fullName,
            email,
            companyName,
            phone,
            jobTitle,
            message,
            leadSource,
            interestArea,
            status,
            assignedTo,
            privacyConsentAccepted,
            created_At

            p.email,
            p.companyName,
            p.phone,
            p.jobTitle,
            p.message,
            p.leadSource,
            p.interestArea,

            p.assignedTo,

        )

            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Check for conflicts against existing table, excluding the record being updated itself
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON LTRIM(RTRIM(LOWER(lc.email))) = p.email
            WHERE lc.leadCaptureId <> p.leadCaptureId

        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Another Lead Capture with this email already exists.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END
